+#include <jni.h>
+#include <stdatomic.h>
+#include <stdbool.h>
+
+static atomic_bool hasEnteredNative = false;
+
+static void wait_for_release() {
+    atomic_store(&hasEnteredNative, true);
+    while (1) {}
+}
+
+JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
+Java_LingeredAppWithNoEhFrame_waitInNative(JNIEnv *env, jobject target) {
+    wait_for_release();
+}
+
+JNIEXPORT jboolean JNICALL
+Java_LingeredAppWithNoEhFrame_hasEnteredNative(JNIEnv *env, jobject target) {
+    return atomic_load(&hasEnteredNative);
+}
